A letter, for you

Siya,

Happy one month, my love.

It's funny how one little yes on September 1st gave me something I now care about so deeply.

In just one month, you've become such an important part of my life. Someone I look forward to talking to, someone whose happiness genuinely matters to me, someone I want beside me through the good days, the difficult days, the stupid days and all the beautiful little moments in between.

I know we're doing this from a distance, and sometimes I wish I could simply cross the distance, show up at your door, steal you away for a walk and hold your hand whenever I miss you.

But until then, I want you to know something:

I'm here.

For you.
For us.
For the days when everything feels easy.
And for the days when it doesn't.

I don't want to just love you when things are perfect. I want to keep choosing you, keep understanding you, keep growing with you and keep becoming a better man for you and for us.

Thank you for choosing me.
Thank you for trusting me.
Thank you for letting me be a part of your life.

You are incredibly special to me, Siya.

And if this is only our first month...

I can't wait to see what the rest of our story looks like.

Yours,
— V ♡

Different places. Same story.

Maybe we don't get to see each other whenever we want.

Maybe I can't randomly show up and say,
"Come, let's go for a walk."

Maybe hugs have to wait.

But none of that changes how important you are to me.

Until the next time I get to hold your hand,
I'll keep choosing you from wherever I am.
